CVE-2020-17049.title: A security feature bypass vulnerability exists in the way Key Dis ...
CVE-2020-17049.description:
A security feature bypass vulnerability exists in the way Key Distribution Center (KDC) determines if a service ticket can be used for delegation via Kerberos Constrained Delegation (KCD).
To exploit the vulnerability, a compromised service that is configured to use KCD could tamper with a service ticket that is not valid for delegation to force the KDC to accept it.
The update addresses this vulnerability by changing how the KDC validates service tickets used with KCD.

CVE-2022-42898.title: PAC parsing in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) before 1.19.4 and 1.20.x ...
CVE-2022-42898.description: PAC parsing in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) before 1.19.4 and 1.20.x before 1.20.1 has integer overflows that may lead to remote code execution (in KDC, kadmind, or a GSS or Kerberos application server) on 32-bit platforms (which have a resultant heap-based buffer overflow), and cause a denial of service on other platforms. This occurs in krb5_pac_parse in lib/krb5/krb/pac.c. Heimdal before 7.7.1 has "a similar bug."

CVE-2023-36054.title: lib/kadm5/kadm_rpc_xdr.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) before 1.20 ...
CVE-2023-36054.description: lib/kadm5/kadm_rpc_xdr.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) before 1.20.2 and 1.21.x before 1.21.1 frees an uninitialized pointer. A remote authenticated user can trigger a kadmind crash. This occurs because _xdr_kadm5_principal_ent_rec does not validate the relationship between n_key_data and the key_data array count.

CVE-2023-39975.description: kdc/do_tgs_req.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.21 before 1.21.2 has a double free that is reachable if an authenticated user can trigger an authorization-data handling failure. Incorrect data is copied from one ticket to another.

CVE-2024-3596.title: RADIUS Protocol under RFC 2865 is susceptible to forgery attacks  ...
CVE-2024-3596.description: RADIUS Protocol under RFC 2865 is susceptible to forgery attacks by a local attacker who can modify any valid Response (Access-Accept, Access-Reject, or Access-Challenge) to any other response using a chosen-prefix collision attack against MD5 Response Authenticator signature.

CVE-2024-37370.title: In MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) before 1.21.3, an attacker can modif ...
CVE-2024-37370.description: In MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) before 1.21.3, an attacker can modify the plaintext Extra Count field of a confidential GSS krb5 wrap token, causing the unwrapped token to appear truncated to the application.

CVE-2024-37371.title: In MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) before 1.21.3, an attacker can cause ...
CVE-2024-37371.description: In MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) before 1.21.3, an attacker can cause invalid memory reads during GSS message token handling by sending message tokens with invalid length fields.

CVE-2025-24528.title: In MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) before 1.22 (with incremental propag ...
CVE-2025-24528.description: In MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) before 1.22 (with incremental propagation), there is an integer overflow for a large update size to resize() in kdb_log.c. An authenticated attacker can cause an out-of-bounds write and kadmind daemon crash.

CVE-2025-3576.title: A vulnerability in the MIT Kerberos implementation allows GSSAPI- ...
CVE-2025-3576.description: A vulnerability in the MIT Kerberos implementation allows GSSAPI-protected messages using RC4-HMAC-MD5 to be spoofed due to weaknesses in the MD5 checksum design. If RC4 is preferred over stronger encryption types, an attacker could exploit MD5 collisions to forge message integrity codes. This may lead to unauthorized message tampering.

CVE-2026-107364.title: krb5: Unauthenticated KDC DoS based on ASN.1 decoder read overrun
CVE-2026-107364.description: In all released versions of MIT krb5, an unauthenticated attacker can cause a KDC process to perform a large read overrun, likely causing the process to terminate.

CVE-2026-107708.title: MIT krb5 through 1.22.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulne ...
CVE-2026-107708.description: MIT krb5 through 1.22.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference vulnerability in the KDC's get_pac_princ_with_realm() that returns success while leaving the client principal NULL on malformed names. A malicious or compromised cross-realm trusted KDC can send an S4U2Proxy request with a PAC carrying a malformed client name to crash krb5kdc and deny authentication.

CVE-2026-107778.title: MIT Kerberos 5 (krb5) through 1.22.2 contains a NULL pointer dere ...
CVE-2026-107778.description: MIT Kerberos 5 (krb5) through 1.22.2 contains a NULL pointer dereference in make_cred_list() in rd_cred.c that allows authenticated Kerberos clients to crash services by sending mismatched KRB-CRED arrays. Attackers can send forwarded credentials with more tickets than ticket_info entries through gss_accept_sec_context() to crash GSS-API acceptor services, causing denial of service.

CVE-2026-107884.title: krb5: Unauthorized key reset of protected principal via kpasswd
CVE-2026-107884.description: In MIT krb5 release 1.15 and later, a client with kadmin administrative privileges can bypass the lockdown_keys attribute by using the password change protocol instead of the kadmin protocol.

CVE-2026-111423.title: krb5: Improper authorization via flawed PAC checksum verification
CVE-2026-111423.description: In MIT krb5 release 1.21 and later, server applications will erroneously treat the PAC within a ticket as verified when the server checksum is invalid.

CVE-2026-112319.description: The GSS-RPC layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not enforce size limits on XDR-decoded data, which allows remote authenticated users to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion or excessive CPU consumption in kadmind) via crafted RPC requests that trigger unbounded memory allocations during XDR decoding.

CVE-2026-112320.title: The GSS-RPC transport layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.4 and  ...
CVE-2026-112320.description: The GSS-RPC transport layer in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.4 and later does not release the previous authentication context when a client switches from an RPCSEC_GSS or AUTH_GSSAPI flavor to a non-GSS flavor on the same TCP connection. This allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion in kadmind) by repeatedly establishing and abandoning GSS authentication contexts.

CVE-2026-112321.description: The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) does not free decoded arguments on certain error paths, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion in kadmind) via crafted AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests that trigger authentication failures.

CVE-2026-112322.title: clean_client() in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (ak ...
CVE-2026-112322.description: clean_client() in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) restarts its scan from the head of the client list after each removal, resulting in quadratic CPU cost. Remote attackers can cause a denial of service (CPU consumption in kadmind) by accumulating a large number of AUTH_GSSAPI client entries.

CVE-2026-112323.title: The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT Kerbe ...
CVE-2026-112323.description: The AUTH_GSSAPI handler in lib/rpc/svc_auth_gssapi.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.5.2 and later allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (memory exhaustion in kadmind) by sending repeated failed AUTH_GSSAPI_INIT requests. Each failed request allocates client state that is only freed after a 15-minute expiration timeout, allowing an attacker to accumulate memory faster than it is reclaimed.

CVE-2026-119079.description: decode_sequence_of() in lib/krb5/asn.1/asn1_encode.c in MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) 1.11 and later grows the decoded element array one entry at a time, which allows remote attackers to cause a denial of service (CPU consumption in the KDC) by sending an unauthenticated AS-REQ or TGS-REQ with a large number of elements in a SEQUENCE OF field over TCP.

CVE-2026-40355.title: In MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) before 1.22.3, there is a NULL point ...
CVE-2026-40355.description: In MIT Kerberos 5 (aka krb5) before 1.22.3, there is a NULL pointer dereference if an application calls gss_accept_sec_context() on a system with a NegoEx mechanism registered in /etc/gss/mech. An unauthenticated remote attacker can trigger this, causing the process to terminate in parse_nego_message.

An unauthenticated remote attacker can trigger this, possibly causing the process to terminate in parse_message.
